testcase.name: Scenario: Return a staged command after selecting another source row: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/ribbon-customization-identity-support/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1346:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Return a staged command after selecting another source row ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And "2D Sketches" is staged in the target list ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the target list ✔ And the user selects "2-D Drawing" in the available commands list ✔ And the user clicks the remove command button ✔ Then the target list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ And the target retains its pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list again ✔ And "2-D Drawing" remains available in the source list ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
